# Decision variables: 1 if child is taken, 0 otherwise
children = ["Harry", "Hermione", "Ron", "Fred", "George", "Ginny"]
cost = {
    "Harry": 1200,
    "Hermione": 1650,
    "Ron": 750,
    "Fred": 800,
    "George": 800,
    "Ginny": 1500
}
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("take", children, lowBound=0, upBound=1, cat=pulp.LpBinary)

prob += pulp.lpSum(x[c] for c in children) <= 4

prob += x["Harry"] + x["George"] <= 1

prob += x["George"] <= x["Fred"]
prob += x["George"] <= x["Hermione"]

# Solve
prob.solve(pulp.PULP_CBC_CMD(msg=False, timeLimit=60))

# storage parameters

sell = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("Sell", quarters, lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')

    prev_inv = inventory[q]

# Capacity constraints

# Sales limits
